name: Plaisio Code
subtitle: The Plaisio Code iPhone app
description: Add this source to install Plaisio Code and get its updates.

apps.name: Plaisio Code
apps.subtitle: Plaisio product lookup
apps.localizedDescription: Scan a barcode or search to find the Plaisio product code, price and store stock.
apps.versionDescription: New look, built like a shelf tag: four tabs at the bottom (Code, Scan, Assistant, More); a big keypad finds a 7-digit Plaisio code as you type it; a scanned product shows as a shelf label with a huge price, the Chania stock on black signs and big keys under it; the Assistant's kinds are photo tiles with a red bar to hold and speak

versions.localizedDescription: New look, built like a shelf tag: four tabs at the bottom (Code, Scan, Assistant, More); a big keypad finds a 7-digit Plaisio code as you type it; a scanned product shows as a shelf label with a huge price, the Chania stock on black signs and big keys under it; the Assistant's kinds are photo tiles with a red bar to hold and speak

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan EAN barcodes to find the Plaisio product code.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Turns what you say into text to find it on the Chania shelf.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Hold the microphone to say what a customer is looking for.
privacy.NFCReaderUsageDescription: Reads a shelf label's tag to set what it shows.
